degree_rationale: Treats Eudaimonia/Sophia/Power (Goodness/Wisdom/Power) as the three foundational principles by which Father, Mother of Life, and the Living Spirit are. This is essential trinity-mapping at the highest level.
direction_rationale: Continues the foundational establishment of celestial essences in their originating triad. Each principle is set in its great land of light alone, before unfolding.
grand_man_function: The threefold celestial inmost — being, knowing, and acting at the Father-source.
title: Wisdom, Power, and Goodness as the three foundational principles of cosmos and Father
